Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

micropubr 0.3.0

Differential abundance

  • mp_run_da() is rebuilt around one shared design for every method:
    • several methods in one call (method = c("wilcox", "lm", "ancombc2")), returned as one long table with method and contrast columns;
    • multi-group designs: every level against reference, or all pairs with pairwise = TRUE (previously only two groups);
    • covariate adjustment with adjust and repeated measures with random;
    • a common prevalence filter (prevalence = 0.1) and multiple-testing correction (p.adjust.method);
    • new engines "lm" (linear model on CLR values; linear mixed model via lmerTest with random) and "ancombc2" (ANCOM-BC2, with structural zeros and the pseudo-count sensitivity flag in the new robust column). "ancombc" is now an alias of "ancombc2";
    • DESeq2 now uses poscounts size factors, so sparse tables no longer fail.
  • mp_diff() gains plot.type = "heatmap" (fold changes across contrasts), "consensus" (agreement across methods), and "zeros" (structural zeros), plus contrast, robust.only and top.n arguments. Multi-contrast and multi-method results are faceted. ANCOM-BC2 results that fail its pseudo-count sensitivity analysis are not counted as significant by default (robust.only = TRUE, matching ANCOM-BC2’s diff_robust): in a confounding simulation on real counts nearly all of ANCOM-BC2’s false positives failed that analysis. A named list of results is stacked for comparison, and "concordance" works on a single two-method result.
  • Forest and dot plots now draw the top.n most significant features (default 30; per panel when faceted) instead of every significant one, and say in the caption how many are shown; their legends no longer list “NS”.

Bug fixes

  • ANCOM-BC2 results were plotted from the intercept column (lfc_(Intercept)) rather than the group effect, and on a log2 axis although ANCOM-BC estimates are natural logarithms. Both are fixed, and covariate terms are no longer mistaken for group contrasts.
  • Results from the original ANCOMBC::ancombc() (whose res is a list of tables) could not be parsed; mp_run_da(method = "ancombc") failed for the same reason and also ignored the requested reference group.
  • ALDEx2 results were plotted using the standardised effect size instead of the log2 difference diff.btw.
  • mp_ordination() drew ellipses for groups of three samples, which stat_ellipse() cannot estimate; it now needs four.
  • Composition plots (mp_taxa(), mp_chord(), mp_longitudinal()) folded abundant taxa that are unassigned at the plotted rank into “Other”, so fewer than top.n taxa were shown. They are now kept and labelled by their deepest assigned rank (e.g. “Unassigned Lachnospiraceae”).
  • Group-comparison p-values (Wilcoxon, t-test, Kruskal-Wallis, ANOVA, Tukey HSD) were taken from rstatix, which rounds them to three significant digits before micropubr adjusted and printed them. They are now computed exactly with stats.
  • PCoA axis percentages are now relative to the sum of all eigenvalues, as in ape::pcoa() and phyloseq, so labels match when negative eigenvalues occur.
  • mp_dispersion() rotates long group labels, and mp_taxa() wraps long facet labels instead of truncating them.
  • README: the mp_import_qiime2() example used a non-existent argument.

Reporting and reproducibility

  • New mp_methods(): a methods paragraph, software versions, references and statistical notes, generated from the provenance every figure now records.
  • New mp_alt_text(): accessible alt text for any micropubr figure.
  • Statistical guardrails flag small groups, richness compared across very uneven sequencing depths, PERMANOVA with unequal dispersions (PERMDISP is now run alongside every PERMANOVA in mp_ordination()), methods that ignored the requested covariates, and covariates so strongly associated with the grouping (Cramer’s V >= 0.7, or R-squared >= 0.5) that adjusting for them is unstable. Control them with mp_set_defaults(guardrails = "warn" | "caption" | "off").

Themes

  • New mp_darken() recolours a finished figure for a dark background while keeping its layout. Adding mp_theme_dark() to a finished plot replaces the whole theme, which undid rotated axis labels and facet strips and left labels and significance brackets drawn in black invisible.
  • Composition and differential-abundance labels no longer treat placeholders such as MGnify’s “Root” or QIIME’s “Unassigned” as taxon names.
  • mp_methods(format = "list") now returns the paragraph without its software sentence, plus versions and citations, so figures described one at a time can share a single software sentence.

Interoperability

  • Every mp_*() function accepts a TreeSummarizedExperiment (or SummarizedExperiment), and the new mp_as_phyloseq() converts one explicitly, including its row tree.

Infrastructure

  • Statistical equivalence tests against vegan, phyloseq and stats, fixture-based tests for real ANCOM-BC/ANCOM-BC2 output, and vdiffr visual regression tests.
  • GitHub Actions for R CMD check, test coverage, BiocCheck and the pkgdown site; inst/CITATION and codemeta.json.

micropubr 0.2.0

  • New interactive argument on every ggplot-based plotting function. With interactive = TRUE they return a plotly widget instead of a static ggplot: hover tooltips, zoom/pan and legend toggling, with the ggplot subtitle and caption preserved. Multi-panel output (multiple measures or mp_combine() figures) is assembled into a single plotly::subplot() with a deduplicated shared legend. Supported by mp_alpha(), mp_ordination(), mp_taxa(), mp_diff(), mp_longitudinal(), mp_function(), mp_network(), mp_tree(), mp_dispersion(), mp_mantel(), mp_varpart(), mp_prevalence(), mp_indicator(), mp_ml() and mp_combine(). The circular circlize-based figures (mp_chord(), mp_circos(), mp_coverage()) are not ggplots and have no interactive mode. Requires the new (suggested) plotly package.
  • New mp_qc_profile(): per-cycle FASTQ read-quality profiles (the diagnostic used to pick DADA2/QIIME 2 truncation lengths) as a frequency heatmap or a mean ± inter-quartile ribbon, with mean/quartile overlays and a Q-score reference line. Reads FASTQ via the lightweight ShortRead backend, or accepts a pre-computed per-cycle data frame, and supports interactive and return.data like the rest of the family.
  • mp_export() now saves an interactive widget to a self-contained .html page (via htmlwidgets) when given one.
  • Both vignettes gained a live “Interactive figures” section.
  • New mp_ml(): supervised machine learning (random forest and xgboost) for microbiome classification and regression, with k-fold cross-validation and "importance", "roc", "confusion" and "prediction" plots. Like the other functions it returns a tidy importance table (with the fitted model and performance metrics attached) when return.data = TRUE.
  • New mp_chord(): chord diagram linking the top taxa to the levels of a grouping variable (via circlize).
  • mp_circos() gained colour/weight-mapped links (link.by), multi-sample coverage tracks, a real heatmap track, feature-type annotation colours (annotation.by), configurable track heights and an optional legend.
  • x-axis tick labels now rotate automatically when categories are many or long (mp_alpha(), mp_longitudinal()), so they no longer overlap.
  • mp_tree() no longer prints the harmless “more than one class ‘phylo’ in cache” diagnostic emitted when phyloseq and tidytree/ggtree are loaded together.
  • Two new vignettes: “Visualization gallery” and “Statistics, machine learning and genomics”.

micropubr 0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Core plotting family: mp_alpha(), mp_ordination(), mp_taxa(), mp_diff(), mp_tree(), mp_network(), mp_longitudinal() and mp_function().
  • Infrastructure: mp_palette(), the mp_theme_*() family, mp_combine(), mp_export(), the mp_import_*() helpers and the interactive mp_explore() Shiny gadget.
  • Colourblind-safe default palettes and a clean publication theme applied across all functions.
  • Automatic statistical overlays (pairwise tests, PERMANOVA) and reproducible, auto-generated figure captions.
